source.name: CSI ETABS official User Guide and product menu documentation
source.note: Functional taxonomy follows documented menu categories, not a pixel-level copied or claimed proprietary ribbon.

menus.etabs_purpose: Declare materials, sections, mass, patterns, cases
Apply boundary restraints, supports, member sections and loads
menus.our_delegation: Supports and load assignments with source IDs

menus.etabs_purpose: Assemble model, solve load cases and inspect logs
Show forces, deformation, reactions and modal results
Check members and design strengths/code combinations
menus.our_delegation: RC code and capacity calculation modules

menus.etabs_purpose: Extend functions and work with source imports

menus.our_delegation: Learning guide and cited reference library

entities.name: source_documents
entities.records: Source PDF/DXF/model or code name, checksum, URI, document class
entities.proof_rule: Immutable original; data is source, not approval

entities.name: sections
entities.proof_rule: One section applies to many members

entities.name: supports
entities.proof_rule: Do not default all footings FIXED without proof

entities.name: load_assignments
entities.records: Target element/area/node, pattern, magnitude, direction, units
entities.proof_rule: No location invented from a PDF total

entities.name: solver_runs
entities.records: Input set, OpenSees version, model hash, logs

entities.name: results
entities.records: run, node/element, response kind, value, units, step

entities.name: design_checks
entities.records: Governing rule, member, demand, capacity, status

entities.name: report_sections
entities.records: TOC sequence, generated narrative, evidence pointers
entities.proof_rule: Chapter view is a joined projection, not source of truth

normalization.meaning: A table describes one kind of object; a row (record) is one instance; a key identifies that instance. Foreign keys join records to their sources and dependent objects.
normalization.goal: 3NF/BCNF where appropriate, immutable revisions and explicit provenance. 6NF is a specialized temporal normalization option, not a blanket default.

code_library.issue: NBC205:2024 RUD eligibility and cross-edition reconciliation cannot be assumed

loads: Element selfweight from geometry and mass density
Slab dead/finish/partition using plan geometry and areas
Live load from actual room occupation and authoritative occupancy code
Masonry line loads along proven wall paths
Wind/earthquake with validated site, mass and code basis
support_load_truth.rule: No actual support or load location should be inferred only from a source report's total force or period.
